exposure: Timing of SSc diagnosis (during reproductive age)
outcome: Adherence to female cancer screening programs
Sexual function (Female Sexual Function Index score)
Concerns about capacity to care for children
cohort: The study included 168 Systemic Sclerosis (SSc) patients who participated in an anonymous self-reported questionnaire during scheduled visits in an outpatient Rheumatology SSc Clinic.
finding: The study found that systemic sclerosis negatively impacts sexual function and adherence to regular gynecological visits, and receiving an SSc diagnosis during reproductive age may increase the likelihood of a reduced desired family size.
